summary: Feature implemented by reading and editing only; no tests or repository code were run and nothing was committed. New modules: monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver). Added plot_2d_or_3d_image to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py. Changed write_nifti default dtype to np.float32. Rewrote SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver, and TensorBoardImageHandler as thin adapters over the savers and plot function, with the specified constructor parameters (output_dir, filename, index). Renamed output_path to output_dir in two segmentation examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py. Added tests test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, and updated test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename. Choices: ClassificationSaver registers a handler-side _finalize(engine) wrapper so the CSV saver takes no engine; TensorBoard handler calls batch_transform once per iteration. None of the tests have been executed, so they are unverified.
